descGu: Data ના clues ઓળખો! AI ઠીક આ કરે.
descEn: Find clues in data — just like AI!
descDa: Find spor i data — ligesom AI gør!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: Data = information numbers. Average = sum ÷ count. Correlation = linked things. AI = pattern in data find.
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Data = information in numbers. Average = sum divided by count. AI finds patterns in massive data sets.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Data er information gemt som tal. Gennemsnit = sum delt med antal. AI finder mønstre i store mængder data.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Yuval game scores: 8,9,7,10,6. Average = 40÷5=8. Computer leaderboard same math!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Yuval's game scores: 8, 9, 7, 10, 6. Sum = 40. Count = 5. Average = 40 / 5 = 8 points per game!
teacherGuide.storyDa: Yuvals spil-scorer: 8, 9, 7, 10, 6. Sum = 40. Antal = 5. Gennemsnit = 40 delt med 5 = 8 point per spil!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'Data = clues! Detective clues ભેગા → case solve. AI data ભેગા → pattern find → future predict!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Data is like clues for a detective. The more clues you gather, the better you solve the mystery. AI does this to make predictions!
teacherGuide.scriptDa: Data er ligesom spor for en detektiv. Jo flere spor du samler, jo nemmere løser du gåden. AI gør dette for at forudsige fremtiden!
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Yuval game scores track! Average calculate together. YouTube history — AI tracked your pattern!
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Track some daily scores or weather degrees. Calculate the average together. Show how a weather chart plots data.
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Mål temperaturer over 3 dage og beregn gennemsnittet sammen. Vis, hvordan søgehistorik bruges af AI til at foreslå videoer.

questions.textEn: Which friend has the highest score?
questions.textDa: Hvilken ven har den højeste score?

questions.textEn: Scores 6, 8, and 10. Add them and ÷ 3 = average?
questions.textDa: Scorerne 6, 8 og 10. Læg dem sammen og del med 3. Hvad er gennemsnittet?

questions.textEn: Rain → umbrella sales go up. This is a ___.
questions.textDa: Regnvejr gør, at der sælges flere paraplyer. Hvad kaldes dette?
questions.hintDa: To ting, der hænger sammen = et mønster!

questions.textEn: AI sees 1000 cat + 1000 dog photos → learns to ___
questions.textDa: AI ser 1000 kattebillede og 1000 hundebilleder. Den lærer at ___
questions.hintGu: AI trains on data — pattern find!
questions.hintEn: AI trains on data — that's Machine Learning!
questions.hintDa: AI træner på data for at lære at genkende mønstre!
